items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Lawrence and we had Boots playing trombones, playing the bass. Jim Crow playing the trombone.

ctx.x: And the Navy Dodds was supposed to be there. Be there, yeah. He had his arm or something so they got me there. Yeah, he got me that last minute to come and record. Still had on your uniform, I remember.

Yeah, yeah, it was a night at the old artesian hall, called the Night in New Orleans. I made a recording that night. It was Wooden Joe, they weren't there playing... Yes, Wooden Joe and Burbank and Lawrence. Lawrence and we had Boots playing trombones, playing the bass. Jim Crow playing the trombone. That's right. The night we made it recorded.
And you got out of the Navy then just a few months after that in August.
